businessModel: Free for participants. Organizations contract with Zeist outside the app to run testimonial campaigns. No in-app purchases, subscriptions or checkout in the mobile app.
registrationModel: Open registration joins the Insight Scoop Starter campaign. A valid organization invitation creates a new account in that organization; existing accounts are never silently moved.
retentionSchedule: By default, submitted campaign media, transcripts and analysis are scheduled for removal six months after campaign completion. For the open starter campaign, the reference date is your latest submission. A different client-required period must be explained in the campaign notice before you record; it does not override applicable law or valid deletion rights. Limited records may be retained where necessary for a documented legal obligation, security investigation or dispute, and are restricted to that purpose.
backupDeletionPeriod: Recovery backups are access-restricted and expire under the applicable backup/provider rotation schedule. A single maximum expiry period has not yet been verified across all recovery systems; contact Zeist for the schedule applicable to your request. Deleted accounts must remain unavailable if a backup is restored, and accepted deletion requests must be reapplied before normal access resumes.
